title: Telecom tower (250 ft), new construction on leased rural land — Utuado, SRC rustic land
description: Our company will build a new 250-foot telecommunications tower on leased rural land in Utuado. It is new construction of a cell tower.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0643/0644: project_type new_construction / renovation -> OGPe construction permit (Ley 161-2009). (KB: RULE_0643)

A 250 ft structure exceeds 200 ft AGL, so FAA Form 7460-1 notice is required (14 CFR 77.9(a)); the process graph models this notice only for energy facilities. Telecom towers now carry the FAA notice as a KB document (RULE_0737); the energy process stays valid for energy facilities.
Ley 89-2000 Arts. 5, 7, 8: tower setbacks, co-location sworn statement and neighbor notice are part of the tower's permit file. (KB: RULE_0736)
A tower that needs FAA notice must be registered with the FCC (47 CFR 17.4). (KB: RULE_0738)

mustNotInclude.rationale: Pin in FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway, which zone X never sets.
Pin outside the official coastal zone (NOAA CZMA answered 'outside'): RULE_0708 needs location.czm. A coastal-flagged municipio alone must not trigger it.
No renewable installation: RULE_0610 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No renewable installation: RULE_0611 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No microgrid stated: PT_MICROGRID needs microgrid_configuration=true; energy.test.ts: 'a rooftop system is not assumed to be a microgrid'.
Existing business: normalizeEntityFormationRequirements never adds formation steps for existing_business / project_only, and entityNotFormed is false.

notes: 2026-10-04: profile moved from the Utility Contractor proxy to the new Telecommunications Tower Operator business type; the Negociado de Telecomunicaciones tower registry is modeled as a heuristic card (needs expert review).
